questions.grammar_rule: Present Simple: Use base verb + s/es for third person singular (he/she/it)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Present Simple: Uchinchi shaxs birlik (u) uchun fe'lga -s/-es qo'shiladi
questions.explanation: With 'she' (third person singular), we add 's' to the verb 'go' = 'goes'

questions.grammar_rule: Present Simple: Use base verb for I/you/we/they
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Present Simple: Men/sen/biz/ular uchun fe'lning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: With 'they' (plural), we use the base form of the verb without 's'

questions.grammar_rule: Present Continuous: am/is/are + verb-ing
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Present Continuous: am/is/are + fe'l-ing
questions.explanation: With 'I', we use 'am' for Present Continuous tense

questions.sentence: Which sentence is in Present Simple?
questions.grammar_rule: Present Simple describes habits, facts, and routines
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Present Simple odatlar, faktlar va muntazam harakatlarni ifodalaydi
questions.explanation: Present Simple uses the base verb (+ s/es for he/she/it) without auxiliary verbs

questions.grammar_rule: Use 'doesn't' (does not) with he/she/it in negative Present Simple
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Present Simple inkorida he/she/it bilan 'doesn't' ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: For third person singular negatives, we use 'doesn't' not 'don't'

questions.sentence: Look! The children ___ in the park.
questions.grammar_rule: Present Continuous: Use for actions happening now, often with 'Look!' or 'Listen!'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Present Continuous: Hozir bo'layotgan harakatlar uchun, ko'pincha 'Look!' yoki 'Listen!' bilan
questions.explanation: 'Look!' signals that the action is happening now, requiring Present Continuous

questions.grammar_rule: Past Simple: Use the past form of the verb for completed actions
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Past Simple: Tugallangan harakatlar uchun fe'lning o'tgan zamon shakli
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' indicates past time, so we use Past Simple 'went' (irregular past of 'go')

questions.grammar_rule: Past Simple: Regular verbs add -ed, irregular verbs have special forms
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Past Simple: Oddiy fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi, noto'g'ri fe'llarning maxsus shakllari bor
questions.explanation: 'Last night' indicates past time. 'Do' becomes 'did' in Past Simple

questions.sentence: I ___ in this city for five years.
questions.grammar_rule: Present Perfect: Use for actions that started in the past and continue to the present
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Present Perfect: O'tmishda boshlangan va hozirga qadar davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun
questions.explanation: 'For five years' (duration until now) requires Present Perfect

questions.sentence: I have saw that movie before.
questions.correct_answer: I have seen that movie before.
questions.grammar_rule: Present Perfect: have/has + past participle (not past simple)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Present Perfect: have/has + past participle (o'tgan zamon shakli emas)
questions.explanation: After 'have', use the past participle 'seen', not the past simple 'saw'

questions.grammar_rule: Present Perfect formation: Subject + have/has + past participle
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Present Perfect: Ega + have/has + past participle
questions.explanation: Transform Past Simple to Present Perfect: 'ate' becomes 'have eaten'

questions.sentence: While I ___ TV, the phone rang.
questions.grammar_rule: Past Continuous: Use for an ongoing action interrupted by another action
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Past Continuous: Boshqa harakat tomonidan to'xtatilgan davom etayotgan harakat uchun
questions.explanation: 'While' + Past Continuous shows a longer action interrupted by a shorter one (Past Simple)

questions.sentence: By the time she arrived, we ___ dinner.
questions.grammar_rule: Past Perfect: Use for an action completed before another past action
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Past Perfect: Boshqa o'tgan harakatdan oldin tugallangan harakat uchun
questions.explanation: 'By the time' with a past event requires Past Perfect for the earlier action

questions.sentence: This time tomorrow, I ___ on the beach.
questions.grammar_rule: Future Continuous: Use for an action in progress at a specific time in the future
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Future Continuous: Kelajakda ma'lum vaqtda davom etayotgan harakat uchun
questions.explanation: 'This time tomorrow' indicates a specific future moment, requiring Future Continuous

questions.sentence: If I will see him, I will tell him.
questions.correct_answer: If I see him, I will tell him.
questions.grammar_rule: First Conditional: Use Present Simple after 'if', not 'will'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Birinchi shart gap: 'if' dan keyin Present Simple ishlatiladi, 'will' emas
questions.explanation: In First Conditional, the 'if' clause uses Present Simple, not future tense

questions.correct_answer: She had left before I arrived.
hints: had + past participle for the earlier action
questions.grammar_rule: Past Perfect shows which action happened first in the past
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Past Perfect o'tmishda qaysi harakat birinchi bo'lganini ko'rsatadi
questions.explanation: The leaving happened before the arriving, so 'left' becomes 'had left'

questions.sentence: By next year, she ___ here for a decade.
questions.grammar_rule: Future Perfect Continuous: Use for duration up to a future point
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Future Perfect Continuous: Kelajakdagi nuqtaga qadar davomiylik uchun
questions.explanation: 'For a decade' + future time marker requires Future Perfect Continuous

questions.sentence: I wish I ___ more time to study.
questions.grammar_rule: Wish + Past Simple expresses an unreal present situation
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Wish + Past Simple hozirgi nohaqiqiy vaziyatni ifodalaydi
questions.explanation: 'I wish' for present situations requires Past Simple to show unreality

questions.sentence: I have been knowing him for years.
questions.correct_answer: I have known him for years.
questions.grammar_rule: Stative verbs (know, like, believe) are not used in continuous tenses
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Holat fe'llari (know, like, believe) davomli zamonlarda ishlatilmaydi
questions.explanation: 'Know' is a stative verb and cannot be used in continuous form

questions.original_sentence: First I will finish the book, then she will arrive.
questions.correct_answer: By the time she arrives, I will have finished the book.
hints: Future Perfect for the completed action
questions.grammar_rule: Future Perfect: will have + past participle for action completed before a future point
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Future Perfect: Kelajakdagi nuqtadan oldin tugallanadigan harakat uchun
questions.explanation: Future Perfect shows completion before another future event
